Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. I answered inline below and attached a short export with our SIG draft for the crypto section ("SIG_Answers_v2.pdf"). If anything needs to be worded differently for your auditors, tell me what they prefer and we can adjust.

1) TLS / in-transit encryption:
- All external client traffic to Redwood hosted endpoints is TLS 1.2+ with strong cipher suites (we prioritize TLS 1.3 where supported). We disallow known weak ciphers (RC4, export ciphers) and use ECDHE for forward secrecy. Termination occurs at our edge LB; internal service-to-service traffic also uses mTLS for control-plane calls.
- Evidence: TLS config excerpt, external probe results available on request.

2) At-rest encryption & key rotation:
- Customer data is encrypted at rest using envelope encryption. Data keys (DEKs) are generated per-tenant and encrypted (wrapped) with a key-encryption-key (KEK) held in our KMS.
- Rotation policy: Data keys (DEKs) are automatically rotated on a rolling schedule by default every 90 days; customers on Dedicated/Private can opt to reduce/increase frequency. KEKs (wrapping keys) are rotated annually (365 days) and rotation is coordinated to preserve availability via key versioning.
- We retain rotation metadata and audit logs for 12 months by default; longer retention is available as an enterprise option.

3) KMS / HSM details:
- Hosted API: Redwood-managed KMS (cloud provider KMS) with envelope encryption. The cloud KMS is HSM-backed by the provider; we maintain audit logs (CloudTrail / KMS Audit).
- Private / VPC or on-prem deployments: we support customer-supplied keys (BYOK) and can integrate with customer HSMs or Redwood-managed HSM appliances. For highest-assurance customers we offer HSM-backed root keys (e.g., Thales Luna) for key wrapping.
- FIPS: For our HSM-backed options we can provide FIPS 140-2/140-3 certificates for the appliance (attached sample). For cloud-managed KMS we can provide the provider's attestation and our SOC 2 artifact references.

4) BYOK support:
- BYOK is supported for Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). Hosted (multi-tenant) uses Redwood-managed keys by default; for hosted customers that require dedicated key material we provide Dedicated offerings with customer-managed keys under contract.

Attached: SIG_Answers_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB) — contains the completed crypto section and a high-level diagram. Also linking a drive folder with rotation logs and sample certs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-crypto-evidence

Cc'ing Neha for implementation specifics and Mina for legal/comms if you need formal attestation. If you need a signed statement or a copy of FIPS certs, let me know which documents to drop in the folder and we'll add them.

Regards,

Short answers you can paste into the SIG:
- DEK rotation: "Data encryption keys are rotated automatically every 90 days by default; rotation metadata and key version history are recorded in our KMS audit logs and provided as rotation exports."
- KEK/root handling: "Key-encryption-keys (KEKs) are stored only within HSM-backed key stores; Redwood does not persist plaintext KEKs outside of HSM memory. KEKs are rotated annually and versions are tracked to allow safe rewrapping without downtime."
- BYOK scope: "BYOK is available for Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments. Hosted multi-tenant endpoints use Redwood-managed keys by default; customers requiring customer-managed keys should engage our Dedicated/Private offerings."
